ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 9:1 ratio of high-intensity white/light-gray pixels to low-intensity black pixels localized along the trailing edge border and scattered focal points.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Broad contiguous white region across both lobes. A thin, irregular dark border (5-20 pixel width) follows the trailing edge. Multiple discrete, dark sub-circular spots (3-10 pixel diameter) are mapped across the central and right lobe white surfaces.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with an approximate angle of 55 degrees; notch depth is approximately 12% of the total visible vertical height of the fluke lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude irregular serrations along the entire visible trailing edge, with individual peak-to-valley amplitudes ranging from 3 to 10 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bi-concave curve originating from the median notch, transitioning to convex at the distal extremities of the fluke lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Several localized dark circular pixel clusters on the white surface. Significant yellowish-brown high-contrast textured clusters (barnacle colonies) are located at the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Localized yellow-brown textured encrustations (parasitic or commensal) present on the outer margins/tips of both fluke lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Small specular highlights from water droplets adhering to the surface, creating high-intensity white points against the dark pigmented trailing edge.
